steps.name: types-tokenize-embeddings
steps.summary: types/{portfolio,notion}.ts + lib/{tokenize,embeddings}.ts 4개 utility (tokenize/estimateTokens/extractKeywords + cosineSimilarity/normalize/fixtureEmbedding/mergeScores) + 2 spec 파일 작성, 21개 테스트 통과

steps.name: chunking
steps.summary: lib/chunking.ts (chunkMarkdown/chunkPages/stableHash) — heading-based markdown 분할, 코드블록 분할 금지, FNV-1a stable id, mergeBelowTokens(prev≥threshold && cur<threshold), maxChunksPerPage 트림 + onWarn, tags via extractKeywords. specs/chunking.spec.ts 12 테스트 통과 (전체 33 통과).

steps.name: notion-service
steps.summary: services/notion.ts (server-only) + createNotionService(token, mock, fixtureDir, rateLimitBackoffMs) — queryDatabase/getPageRef/getPageContent/getPagesContent. MOCK 모드 (tests/fixtures/notion/db-projects.json + page-*.md), 실 API 모드 (raw fetch + @notionhq/client v5 + notion-to-md@^3, 한글/영문 속성 키 매핑, 429 backoff 4회, 401/403/404 → null skip). msw 핸들러 3종 (databases query/pages retrieve/blocks children). vitest stub `tests/stubs/server-only.ts` alias. 13 신규 테스트 + 기존 33 = 46개 통과.

steps.name: embeddings-service
steps.summary: services/openai-embeddings.ts (server-only) + createEmbeddingsService(apiKey, mock, baseURL, model, dimensions, maxBatchSize, retryBackoffMs) — embed/embedBatch. MOCK 모드는 lib/embeddings.fixtureEmbedding 재사용, 실 API 모드는 fetch로 POST /v1/embeddings (model=text-embedding-3-small, dimensions=1536). maxBatchSize=96 chunking + 입력 순서 보존. 4xx/5xx 즉시 throw, 429 backoff 4회(250→500→1000→2000ms). msw OpenAI handler 추가 (fixtureEmbedding 사용). 13 신규 테스트 + 기존 46 = 59개 통과.

steps.name: sync-notion
steps.summary: scripts/sync-notion.ts (build script) — env-driven (NOTION_TOKEN/PROJECTS_DB_ID/PROFILE_PAGE_IDS, OPENAI_API_KEY, MOCK_NOTION/MOCK_LLM/SKIP_NOTION_SYNC) flow: queryDatabase(category=자체프로젝트/업무/외부활동) + status filter (Done/In progress) → getPageRef for profile pages → getPagesContent (concurrency=4, onSkip warn) → chunkPages with categoryResolver(profile→career/personal, project categories→project) → embedBatch → sortChunks(sourcePageId→headingPath) → write data/portfolio.server.json + data/portfolio.sample.json (8 chunks/16d sample). KST `+09:00` generatedAt. package.json sync:notion=tsx --conditions=react-server (server-only bypass), prebuild appends sync:notion. specs/sync-notion.spec.ts 6 tests (skip/mock/sample/determinism/missing token/missing key) + 59 prior = 65 통과. AC: build, mock run, SKIP run, missing token error all 통과.

steps.name: portfolio-loader-retriever
steps.summary: lib/portfolio-data.ts (server-only, fs/path) — loadPortfolio (server.json → sample.json fallback, throw on missing), clearPortfolioCache, toClientData (strips chunks/embeddings), 모듈-스코프 cached + JSON.parse + 구조 검증(version/generatedAt/chunks[].id|sourceTitle|tokens|embedding 등). lib/retriever.ts (pure, Edge-호환, no node:*) — retrieve(query, data, opts) → RetrievalSummary { results, mode: 'hybrid'|'keyword-only', empty }: tokenize+heading+tags 매칭으로 keywordScore, queryEmbedding 있으면 cosineSimilarity, mergeScores(0.4/0.6 default), topK=8/maxTokens=6000/minVectorScore=0.3 default, 정렬 후 토큰 컷, 빈 query/빈 chunks/dim mismatch 처리. specs/{portfolio-data,retriever}.spec.ts 16 신규 테스트 + 65 prior = 81 통과. AC: tsc/lint/build/grep 모두 통과.
